ITEM 1 | Dark green spinach-like leaves, flat and mostly whole with some torn edges, spread around the rim and underneath other ingredients, slightly glossy with a fresh, moist look; footprint covers roughly 35% of the bowl, leaves about 0.2 cm thick | 60
ITEM 2 | Pale ivory cubes of firm, opaque meat-like pieces, roughly 1.5 to 2 cm per side, with slightly irregular edges and light golden-brown tinges on some surfaces; scattered across the middle, about 15% of the bowl footprint, piled about 1.5 cm high | 110
ITEM 3 | Pale yellow-green avocado-like wedges and chunks, smooth creamy surface with slight sheen, cut into pieces about 2 to 3 cm long and 1 cm thick, arranged in clusters on the right and lower side, covering about 15% of the bowl, around 1 to 1.5 cm high | 90
ITEM 4 | Thin pale cream-colored shavings and flakes, matte with slightly rough edges and fine crumbly texture, some curled, scattered over the upper left and center, about 10% of the bowl, around 0.3 cm thick | 35
ITEM 5 | Thin orange shreds, matte with slightly stringy texture, short strands about 3 to 5 cm long, scattered across the salad between leaves and other pieces, covering about 4% of the bowl | 10
ITEM 6 | Dark reddish-purple small halved or whole pieces with glossy skin and soft, slightly wrinkled look, roughly 1.5 cm across, clustered in the lower left and center, covering about 6% of the bowl, around 1 cm high | 25
